Here are free solutions for each veterinary business need:

## Patient Management Systems
**OpenVet** - Open-source veterinary practice management software
**Simple Spreadsheets** - Google Sheets or LibreOffice Calc with templates
**Airtable** - Free tier includes robust database features with forms and automation
**Notion** - Free plan allows comprehensive patient tracking with templates

## Appointment Scheduling  
**Calendly** - Free plan for basic scheduling with client self-booking
**Google Calendar** - Free with appointment slots and client booking
**Acuity Scheduling** - Free tier for simple appointment management
**When2meet** - Free group scheduling tool
**Square Appointments** - Free basic scheduling system

## Inventory Management
**inFlow Inventory** - Free version for up to 100 products
**Zoho Inventory** - Free for up to 20 online orders/month
**Google Sheets** - Custom inventory tracking with barcode scanning apps
**ABC Inventory** - Free basic inventory software
**Sortly** - Free visual inventory management

## Billing and Invoice Generation
**Wave Accounting** - Completely free invoicing and basic accounting
**Invoice Ninja** - Free self-hosted invoicing solution
**Zoho Invoice** - Free for up to 5 customers
**PayPal Invoicing** - Free invoice generation and payment processing
**Google Sheets/Docs** - Custom invoice templates

## Client Communication Tools
**Mailchimp** - Free for up to 2,000 contacts
**WhatsApp Business** - Free messaging with business features
**Google Voice** - Free phone number with texting
**Telegram** - Free messaging with broadcast lists
**Buffer** - Free social media scheduling (3 accounts)

## Medical Forms and Documentation
**Google Forms** - Free form creation with automatic responses
**Typeform** - Free tier for basic forms
**JotForm** - Free plan with form templates
**Microsoft Forms** - Free with Microsoft account
**PDFtk** - Free PDF form creation and editing

## Analytics Dashboard
**Google Analytics** - Free website/business analytics
**Google Data Studio** - Free dashboard creation
**Grafana** - Free open-source analytics platform
**Metabase** - Free open-source business intelligence
**Excel/Google Sheets** - Custom dashboards with pivot tables

## Emergency Protocol Systems
**Veterinary Partner** - Free online veterinary encyclopedia
**ASPCA Poison Control** - Free mobile app for poison information
**Plumb's Veterinary Drugs** - Free basic drug information
**Google Keep/Evernote** - Free note-taking for quick reference protocols
**Anki** - Free flashcard system for emergency procedures

## Bonus Free Tools
**Canva** - Free design tool for educational materials and signage
**GIMP** - Free image editing software
**LibreOffice** - Free office suite alternative to Microsoft Office
**Slack** - Free team communication (limited message history)
**Trello** - Free project management and task tracking

Most of these solutions offer paid upgrades with additional features, but their free tiers provide substantial functionality for small to medium veterinary practices just starting out.
